_note: Adjudications for oldest-end batch 07, Aug to Sept 2024. Model claude-opus-5, prompt v1.

reviews.note: A hard date with a strong label attached: turning point and tipping point. Past due and scoreable.
Softens it in the same video: believe now, it does not have to be the 3rd of October. The date is loosened before it arrives.
Kept because it cuts against gold-10k and silver-75 and his standing hold-metals counsel. He endorses the opposite instruction here.
A fleece with a number and a date, so in principle checkable against rainfall records.
Adds that it measured exactly four inches and that he photographed it.
Earliest blade-ear-full telling located, Sept 2024, and it anchors the sequence to Rosh Hashanah 2024 rather than October as the December telling does.
Expectation brings manifestation. Another clause that makes non-arrival the hearer's.
Related to internet-socialist-control but distinct: this is loss of access, not control of content.

Dated to April 2020, before COVID, and framed as another plague still to come. Left unsure because the 2020 origin makes it unclear whether this is the same plague as the later tellings or the one that arrived.
Correction rather than judgment. A relabelling that changes nothing observable.
He removes the date himself: is it coming this year, I don't know.
August 2024, five months left, and the good-year word is being reasserted with a believe-for-big condition attached.
Worth keeping: he explicitly declines the political reading of the nation's recovery, which sits against much of his election material.
Household finances after a church layoff. Background to the wealth-transfer material rather than a claim.
An unnamed figure collapsing in the glory. No identification offered, so nothing to score.
Sourced to someone else, and he leans on that source's two week old accuracy as the reason to believe it.
Supplies the window that makes it scoreable: August to the elections.
Distinct from dam-failure-warning: that is a physical dam, this is the economy as a dam. The two images run in parallel and he does not merge them.
Note the hedge: potential to be, and if we change in the spirit I don't know.
Read from someone else's warning, not his own vision. Source mode records that.
Three independent witnesses invoked, and he states he has not heard a date directly, only that he sees something about 2025.
October again, now October 2024. Left unsure for the same reason as the earlier October tellings: the month recurs across years without him tying them together.
Rare and worth keeping: he tells viewers the word matters more than watching him.
Adds the hearing condition: those seeking him daily will be told whether to relocate.
Presented as a prior word now trying to manifest, which makes the original telling worth locating in the corpus.
